name: Hobbling Snare
text:
You rig vines, ropes, or wires to cinch tight around a creature that triggers this snare. The first creature to enter the square must attempt a DC 20 Reflex save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speed for 1 minute or until it Escapes.

Failure As success, but the penalty is -10 feet.

Critical Failure As success, but the penalty is -20 feet.

Effect: Hobbling Snare
